verdict.rationale: Zero works as a client on top of existing providers. It connects Gmail, Outlook and others into a unified inbox, so a switcher's existing mail stays reachable in place, though nothing describes an actual import of history. There is no evidence of any contacts import, no migration from another client (e.g. mbox/PST), and Gmail access depends on an OAuth setup. Missing for 10: a dedicated mail-history import/migration tool, contacts import, import from other email clients or archive formats, and hands-on corroboration that full history is accessible.
